mapper.select: select doc::text as doc, rev, to_char(updated_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as at from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
insert into tenant_state (tenant_id, doc, rev, bytes) values (#{tid}, cast(#{doc} as jsonb), 1, #{bytes}) on conflict (tenant_id) do nothing returning rev
update tenant_state set doc = cast(#{doc} as jsonb), rev = rev + 1, bytes = #{bytes}, updated_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and rev = #{rev} returning rev
select sid, code_fp from learners where tenant_id = #{tid}
mapper.insert: insert into learners (tenant_id, sid, dept, code_fp, code_hash) values (#{tid}, #{sid}, #{dept}, #{fp}, #{hash}) on conflict (tenant_id, sid) do update set dept = excluded.dept, code_fp = excluded.code_fp, code_hash = excluded.code_hash, pw_hash = null
mapper.delete: delete from learners where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid in #{s}
delete from learner_sessions where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid in #{s}
mapper.update: update tenants set mode = #{mode}, name = #{name} where id = #{tid}
